results.title: Image Editor from Normal to Professional Image (Fork)
results.text: "Transform this image into a professional portrait but strictly keep the exact face, facial structure, skin tone, and natural expression unchanged. Do not change the smile, eyes, nose, or jawline. Only enhance image quality, lighting, and sharpness to make the face clearer and more defined. Slightly enhance the body to appear athletic (broad shoulders, fit chest — natural and realistic). Upgrade hairstyle subtly, keeping the same style but making it cleaner and sharper. Change outfit to a perfectly tailored business suit or smart blazer and shirt in professional colors (navy blue, charcoal grey, or black). Add very subtle stylish details like a watch or pocket square. Replace the background with a clean, minimal studio backdrop (soft gradient or light grey). Use professional, bright, and even lighting, slightly smooth skin while keeping all texture natural. Final result must look exactly like the same person, just more polished, stylish, confident, and LinkedIn-ready."
